---
name: Bug Report
about: Report an import/export problem
title: "[BUG] "
labels: bug
---

## Description
A clear description of what went wrong.

## File Details
- Approximate file size / face count (if known):
- SketchUp version that created the `.skp` file (if known):
- Import or export?

## Steps to Reproduce
What you did. If it's an import problem, attaching the `.skp` file (or a
minimal one that reproduces it) makes this dramatically faster to fix.

## Expected Behavior
What you expected to happen.

## Actual Behavior
What actually happened - include the exact error from Blender's System
Console (Window > Toggle System Console on Windows; launch from a
terminal on Linux/macOS) if there is one.

## Environment
- Blender version: [e.g., 4.5.10 LTS]
- OS: [e.g., Windows 11, Ubuntu 22.04]
- Addon version (from the manifest or the release you downloaded): [e.g., 0.1.0]
